name: Beardbrand
description: Austin, Texas men's grooming brand founded in 2012 selling beard, hair and body products, built on a large educational content community with over one million YouTube subscribers and features in GQ, Men's Health and Forbes.

evidence.summary: Beardbrand's own affiliate page (fetched 2026-11-21) states affiliates earn a 15% commission on every qualified buyer, with a 30-day cookie, and that the program runs on AvantLink with applications via the AvantLink apply link on the page. The page publishes no earnings-cap statement and no creator count, so commission_cap and creator_saturation are recorded as unknown.
The same page states Beardbrand was founded in 2012, is based in Austin, Texas, and has over one million YouTube subscribers, with features in GQ, Men's Health, Forbes, Fast Company and Shark Tank.

reasons.niche_fit: Men's grooming (beard, hair, body) built around creator-style educational content — squarely in the beauty niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page recruits website, blog, vlog, YouTube and Instagram creators, and the brand itself grew through a 1M+ subscriber YouTube community; no creator cohort size is published.
reasons.compensation: A published 15% commission on the brand's own page via AvantLink with a 30-day cookie; no cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliate page into AvantLink; no separate partnerships email was verified.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open now with a public application link on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Established 2012 Austin brand featured by GQ, Men's Health, Forbes and Shark Tank.

description: Arizona-inspired haircare brand selling simple daily-routine products — shampoos, conditioners, styling creams and its signature hair perfume — through its own website, retailers and TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: Rateful's TikTok Shop brand page for dae hair (fetched 2026-11-21) confirms an active TikTok Shop affiliate program: creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access can add its 33 products to their showcase and earn commission on every sale, and about 100% of its estimated $3.4K TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs. TikTok Shop rates are set per product and third-party rate listings conflict (figures from 1.6% to 15% appear), so commission_rate is null. The 100% figure is a share of sales, not a creator count, and no cap statement is published, so cap and saturation are unknown.

reasons.compensation: TikTok Shop commissions are set per product and published listings conflict, so the rate is null; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Access runs through TikTok Shop's affiliate center; no brand-side partnerships contact was verified.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to any creator with TikTok Shop affiliate access — products can be added to a showcase immediately.
reasons.credibility: Established haircare brand with retail distribution and an active TikTok Shop storefront.
